verdict_text: Clean timestamped declaration precedes all audit results, for the core contract. Evidence is local session records and file mtimes (no external anchor such as a pushed git commit existed at declaration time); two post-hoc additions are explicitly labeled below.

core_contract_declared_2026-07-24T22:53Z.population: all 140 DL3DV-Benchmark scenes, nerfacto per-scene PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS generated locally (ns-train defaults, machine.seed 0, downscale 4 / 960P)
